item.name: Rascal
item.howToBuy: Lobby Classes shop → Intern → Skins → purchase with Animal Coins
item.cardSummary: The Intern's signature look. A low-cost first cosmetic if you main the free starter class.

item.name: Assistant Nurse
item.howToBuy: Lobby Classes shop → Nurse → Skins → purchase with Animal Coins
item.cardSummary: Nurse's mid-tier redesign. Spend here when you already like the inventory perk and want a fresh outfit.

item.name: Psycho
item.howToBuy: Lobby Classes shop → Psychologist → Skins → purchase with Animal Coins
item.cardSummary: Psychologist's signature redesign. Same doubled-sanity playstyle with a darker cosmetic identity.

item.name: Hospital Cop
item.howToBuy: Lobby Classes shop → Security → Skins → purchase with Animal Coins
item.cardSummary: Security's premium redesign. A big coin flex for taser and camera players who want the cop look.

item.name: Supervisor
item.howToBuy: Lobby Classes shop → Head Nurse → Skins → purchase with Animal Coins
item.cardSummary: Head Nurse's top-tier redesign. One of the two most expensive signature skins in the shop.

item.name: Agent R
item.howToBuy: Lobby Classes shop → Secret Agent → Skins → purchase with Animal Coins
item.cardSummary: Secret Agent's signature redesign. Cosmetic only—the gun and scanner still come from the class itself.

item.name: Nurse (Classic)
item.howToBuy: Lobby Classes shop → Nurse → Skins → purchase with Animal Coins
item.cardSummary: Nurse's pre-rework model kept as a Classic skin. Cheapest cosmetic in the catalog if you like the old look.

item.name: Paramedic (Classic)
item.howToBuy: Lobby Classes shop → Paramedic → Skins → purchase with Animal Coins
item.cardSummary: Paramedic's Classic look after the class remodel. Low cost if you want the older model instead of the new default.

item.name: Psychologist (Classic)
item.howToBuy: Lobby Classes shop → Psychologist → Skins → purchase with Animal Coins
item.cardSummary: Psychologist's pre-rework Classic model. A budget alternative to the Psycho signature skin.

item.name: Doctor (Classic)
item.howToBuy: Lobby Classes shop → Doctor → Skins → purchase with Animal Coins
item.cardSummary: Doctor's Classic look after the remodel. Currently the only Doctor shop skin—no signature redesign yet.

item.name: Security (Classic)
item.howToBuy: Lobby Classes shop → Security → Skins → purchase with Animal Coins
item.cardSummary: Security's older model sold as Classic. Much cheaper than Hospital Cop if you only want a legacy outfit.

item.name: Head Nurse (Classic)
item.howToBuy: Lobby Classes shop → Head Nurse → Skins → purchase with Animal Coins
item.cardSummary: Head Nurse's Classic pre-rework look. Far cheaper than Supervisor for players who prefer the older model.

item.name: Surgeon (Classic)
item.howToBuy: Lobby Classes shop → Surgeon → Skins → purchase with Animal Coins
item.cardSummary: Surgeon's Classic look after the remodel. No signature redesign yet—this is the only extra Surgeon cosmetic.

item.name: Secret Agent (Classic)
item.howToBuy: Lobby Classes shop → Secret Agent → Skins → purchase with Animal Coins
item.cardSummary: Secret Agent's Classic model. A mid-price alternative if you own the class but do not want Agent R.

item.name: Secretary (Classic)
item.howToBuy: Lobby Classes shop → Secretary → Skins → purchase with Animal Coins
item.cardSummary: Secretary's Classic look after the remodel. Guides list it in the shop but do not publish a confirmed coin price yet—check the lobby cost before buying.
